meta.tagline: From Lean excellence to digital leadership
meta.sampleNotice: Sample figures. Edit the workshop-data block in this file to use your plant's numbers.

achievements.intro: 2026 was the year Lean stopped being a programme and became the way the plant runs.

milestones.title: Value stream redesign, Line 3
milestones.text: New layout cut lead time from 14.5 to 11 days and freed 640 m² of floor space.

milestones.title: Zero-defect cell certified
milestones.text: Final assembly cell ran 90 days without a customer-relevant defect.

milestones.title: AGV fleet live
milestones.text: Six automated guided vehicles took over milk-run supply for Lines 1–3.

milestones.title: BPS assessment level 4
milestones.text: External assessment confirmed level 4 maturity in 6 of 8 BPS principles.

highlights.text: of associates trained in BPS basics

lean.intro: Eight BPS principles, assessed on a five-level maturity scale. The gap between the two bars is the year's work.

principles.name: Process orientation
principles.action: Value streams mapped end to end for all three product families.

principles.name: Pull system
principles.action: Kanban supermarket replaces push scheduling on Lines 1–3.

principles.name: Perfect quality
principles.action: Poka-yoke on 38 failure modes; AI inspection at end of line.

principles.name: Flexibility
principles.action: SMED workshops on every bottleneck machine.

principles.name: Standardisation
principles.action: Standard work sheets digitised and versioned at each station.

principles.name: Transparency
principles.action: Live shop floor boards in three tiers, refreshed every 15 minutes.

principles.name: Continuous improvement
principles.action: 1,240 ideas implemented; weekly kaizen events per line.

principles.name: Personal responsibility
principles.action: Team leaders own their KPIs and run their own problem solving.

stations.title: Value stream, Line A
stations.text: One-piece flow across four stations. Takt 42 s, buffer between stations capped at two parts.

stations.title: SMED at the press cell
stations.text: Changeover cut from 42 to 18 minutes by moving 70% of setup work outside machine stop time.

stations.title: Kanban supermarket
stations.text: Two-bin system with 412 part numbers. Supply is pulled by consumption, not by forecast.

stations.title: Andon and escalation
stations.text: Every stop raises the Andon. Team leader responds within 3 minutes, shift lead within 10.

stations.title: Shop floor management board
stations.text: Tier-2 board: safety, quality, delivery, cost and people, reviewed daily at 08:30.

digital.intro: Six projects connect machines, materials and people. Pick a project to fly to it on the shop floor.

projects.name: Predictive maintenance
projects.text: Vibration and temperature sensors on 46 critical assets feed a failure-prediction model. Maintenance is planned before a breakdown happens.

projects.name: AI visual inspection
projects.text: Camera stations at end of line classify surface defects in 180 ms per part and feed results back to the line.

projects.name: Digital shop floor management
projects.text: Paper boards replaced by live screens across three tiers, with problem-solving tracked to closure.

projects.name: AGV intralogistics
projects.text: Six AGVs run the milk run between supermarket and lines. Four more vehicles join in Q1 2027.

projects.name: Energy monitoring
projects.text: Sub-metering on compressors, ovens and HVAC, with a live CO₂ dashboard per line.

projects.name: Digital twin, Line B
projects.text: A simulation model of Line B to test cycle time, staffing and layout options before touching the floor.

kpis.intro: Twelve months of the plant's eight steering KPIs against their 2026 targets.

strategy.intro: One vision, four pillars, one foundation. Pick a part of the house to see its 2027 commitments.

vision.title: Vision 2027
vision.text: The benchmark plant in our network for quality, flow and digital operations.

pillars.name: Zero-defect quality
initiatives: AI inspection on every end-of-line station
Poka-yoke for the top 50 failure modes
Supplier quality gates for critical parts

pillars.name: End-to-end flow
initiatives: Pull system extended to Lines 4 and 5

pillars.name: Productivity and cost
initiatives: Line balancing with the digital twin

pillars.name: Digital and data
initiatives: Digital twin for Lines A and B
One data platform for all shop floor KPIs

foundation.name: BPS principles and people
initiatives: Problem solving certification for all engineers

closing.title: One team. One BPS. 2027.
commitments: Every KPI has an owner and a weekly review
Every team runs one improvement per week
Every project shows its result on the shop floor board
